title: From gene to protein
compartment: Nucleus for transcription and mRNA processing; cytosol for translation

steps.note: Adds one nucleotide at a time to the 3′ end, complementary to the template
During transcription; forms the 7-methylguanosine cap at the 5′ end

steps.enzyme: Spliceosome (U1, U2, U4/U6 and U5 snRNPs); poly(A) polymerase (PAPOLA)
steps.note: Introns excised; 98.71% of 22,489 mammalian splice-site pairs are GT–AG

steps.enzyme: Ribosome, with elongation factors eEF1A and eEF2
steps.note: Codons read from the AUG start codon to one of three stop codons
